not_found: Measured Mn I radiative lifetimes (Den Hartog et al. 2011 Table 1, 22 levels; Schnabel, Bard, Kock, Z. Phys. D 34, 223 (1995); Marek, A&A 44, 69 (1975); Becker et al. J. Phys. B 13, 2505 (1980); Blackwell-Whitehead et al. MNRAS 2005/2011; Shang et al. JQSRT 2015): none of these could be opened (IOP bot wall, Springer/OUP/Elsevier paywalls); the VizieR copy of Den Hartog 2011 only holds the transition-probability and hfs-pattern tables. Only z6P° lifetimes derived as 1/A are given, flagged "derived".
Lifetimes / new transition probabilities of y6P°, x6P°, y6D°, y6F°, v6P°, z6F°, z4F°->a6D lines (the remaining drawn transitions): nothing measured and newer than NIST located in an openable source.

Precise ground-state hyperfine constant of 55Mn (Davis, Wright, Balling, Phys. Rev. A 3, 1220 (1971)) and Blackwell-Whitehead et al. ApJS 157, 402 (2005) full hfs table: originals not opened; only the rounded values tabulated in Bergemann thesis Table A.3 are given. No hfs constants found for y6D°, y6F°, v6P°, z6F°1/2.
Isotope shifts: 55Mn is the only stable isotope; shifts of radioactive Mn isotopes (collinear laser spectroscopy) not searched.

Precise absolute transition frequencies of Mn I lines: none found (Clear, Nave, Blackwell-Whitehead, arXiv:2511.15521 (2025) give new FTS level energies; its machine-readable level table is not in the PDF).
Experimental laser cooling of Mn: no experiment found; only the proposal remarks of Eustice et al. 2020. Linewidth of the a4H13/2 - z4I°15/2 405/406 nm line: stated as not measured.
Measured Landé g factors beyond the NIST ASD compilation: none found.
notes: Transition probabilities are the recommended values of Den Hartog et al. 2011 (VizieR table3; all Mn I lines of that table are included, also those between levels not drawn on the site). NIST ASD Mn I A-values for these lines come from older references, so these supersede them. Hyperfine A, B are for 55Mn (I = 5/2) and are second-hand, rounded values from a thesis compilation (no uncertainties) - adequate for drawing hyperfine manifolds, not for precision work. rme_J_ea0 values are derived from A_s. The site file labels the 403 nm upper term "3d54s4p z6P°"; energies follow the local NIST file. For the a4H13/2 - z4I°15/2 cooling proposal the transition is identified with NIST levels 34138.88 and 58852.60 cm^-1 (404.6 nm vacuum from those energies); "drawn_on_site" marks what data/mn/levels.csv / transitions.csv contain.
